flows.name: 整页紧凑-原句闭环-接受-刷新-撤销

steps.eval: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-presentation="root"]'); return root ? root.getAttribute('data-arrangement-mode') + ':' + root.getAttribute('data-gap') : 'none'; })()

(() => { const sels = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#chat-scroll .question-select[data-question-id="template_edit_confirm"]')).filter(s => !s.disabled); const sel = sels[sels.length - 1]; if (!sel) return false; const opt = Array.from(sel.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '修改'); if (!opt) return false; sel.value = opt.value; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

(() => { const inputs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#chat-scroll .question-other-input')).filter(x => !x.disabled); if (inputs.length !== 1) return false; const box = inputs[0].closest('.question-other'); return box.dataset.questionOther === 'template_edit_confirm' && box.dataset.answerMode === 'edit' && box.dataset.editAction === '修改'; })()

steps.text: 页面紧凑一点，标题保留，其他内容按阅读顺序排列

steps.eval: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('[data-pending-plan]').innerText; return t.includes('单列连续排布') && t.includes(' PX') && t.includes('保留标题') && t.includes('整页（全部正文卡片）'); })()

(() => { const sel = document.querySelector('[data-pending-plan] select'); const opt = Array.from(sel.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '接受修改'); if (!opt) return false; sel.value = opt.value; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()
(() => { const root = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-presentation="root"]'); return Number(root.getAttribute('data-gap')) === beforeGap - 4; })()
(() => { const root = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-presentation="root"]'); return root ? root.getAttribute('data-gap') : 'none'; })()

(() => { const els = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root [data-region-id][data-placement-type]')); return els.length === 6 && els.every(el => el.getAttribute('data-placement-type') === 'FLOW' && el.getAttribute('data-placement-align') === 'STRETCH'); })()

(() => { const el = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-region-id="region_total_energy"][data-placement-type]'); return !!el && el.getAttribute('data-placement-type') === 'FLOW' && el.getAttribute('data-placement-align') === 'STRETCH'; })()

(() => { const root = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-presentation="root"]'); return !!root && root.getAttribute('data-arrangement-mode') === 'FLOW' && root.getAttribute('data-arrangement-direction') === 'VERTICAL' && Number(root.getAttribute('data-gap')) === beforeGap - 4; })()
(() => { const root = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-presentation="root"]'); return root ? root.getAttribute('data-gap') : 'none'; })()

(() => { const sel = document.querySelector('[data-wp-history]'); if (!sel) return false; const opt = Array.from(sel.options).find(o => o.value === 'undo'); if (!opt || opt.disabled) return false; sel.value = 'undo'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

(() => { const root = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-presentation="root"]'); return !!root && root.getAttribute('data-arrangement-mode') === 'GRID' && Number(root.getAttribute('data-gap')) === beforeGap; })()
